szoveg_eredeti:
Immobiliare.it , Italy’s largest real estate platform, started with a single agent to handle inbound calls on listings, qualify leads, and answer buyers’ questions 24/7, in natural, native-sounding voices across their markets.

That first agent turned out to be a starting point, not a one-off project. Once the team saw how easily the same foundation carried over to new use cases, they kept building. Today Immobiliare.it runs a full agentic network on ElevenAgents:
→ Inbound agent for private sellers
→ Outbound agent to support listing quality
→ Customer support across voice and chat
→ Conversational search to explore listings easily

Read more: https://lnkd.in/gJeTmFvB
